### Problem or Motivation

Is your feature request related to a specific problem or friction in the current workflow? (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

### Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what feature you would like to see added.

### Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context / Mockups

Add any screenshots, mockups, or examples of existing tools that do something similar.
